title: An etale equivalence relation on a scheme presents an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Theorem: for a scheme U over S and an etale equivalence relation j = (s, t) : R -> U x_S U on U over S, the quotient U/R is an algebraic space and U -> U/R is etale and surjective, so that (U, R, U -> U/R) is a presentation (source lines 1819-1827). The proof reduces first to U' = U by replacing U with a surjective etale U' -> U (using that U/R = U'/R' and that R' is again an etale equivalence relation), then to U = coproduct U_i with each U_i affine, applies the affine case to each restriction, uses the coproduct lemma to make the coproduct of the F_i an algebraic space, and finishes by gluing along the open immersions F_i -> F.
